Primary Composite Response Criteria
data.description: Primary endpoint response definition at Week 52
data.text: Simultaneously achieving clinical remission and at least 10% weight reduction at Week 52 without early permanent discontinuation of study intervention or taking specified prohibited medication

data.name: Moderately to Severely Active UC
data.description: Disease activity eligibility condition confirmed by central review
data.text: mMS of 5 to 9 points and Endoscopic Subscore of 2 to 3 (confirmed by central review) within 21 days before Visit 2

data.name: Established UC Diagnosis
data.description: Diagnostic eligibility condition
data.text: Established diagnosis of UC for ≥3 months before Visit 2, including endoscopic evidence of UC and a histopathology report supporting a diagnosis of UC

data.name: Weight Eligibility Condition
data.description: Obesity or overweight plus comorbidity requirement
data.text: Obesity (BMI ≥30 kg/m2) OR overweight (BMI ≥27 to <30 kg/m2) with at least 1 weight-related comorbid condition: hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, dyslipidemia, obstructive sleep apnea, or cardiovascular disease

data.name: Age Eligibility Condition
data.description: Age range for participation
data.text: ≥18 to ≤70 years of age

data.name: COVID-19 Rescreening Condition
data.description: Condition permitting rescreening after COVID-19 screen failure
data.text: Symptomatic participants: at least 14 days have passed since recovery (resolution of fever without antipyretics and improvement in symptoms). Asymptomatic participants: at least 14 days have passed since the first positive molecular (e.g., PCR) test result.

data.name: Cytomegalovirus Colitis Re-eligibility Condition
data.description: Conditional eligibility despite prior CMV colitis
data.text: Participants may be eligible if they have had adequate treatment of cytomegalovirus-associated colitis and resolution of symptoms at least 3 months prior to screening colonoscopy, provided all other eligibility criteria are met

data.name: Ustekinumab Washout Exception Condition
data.description: Drug-level based exception to 16-week washout
data.text: Exclusion does not apply if the participant has a result from a validated drug-level test demonstrating undetectable drug level in the period between last dose and the screening visit

data.name: Advanced Therapy Failure Limit
data.description: Prior therapy failure exclusion condition
data.text: Participants who have failed 4 or more classes of advanced therapies approved for the treatment of UC are excluded

data.name: Active Infection Exclusion Conditions
data.description: Infection-based exclusion conditions at screening
data.text: Current HBV infection (HBsAg positive and/or PCR positive for HBV DNA), current HCV infection (HCV RNA positive), known active COVID-19 infection, C. difficile or other intestinal infection within 30 days of screening colonoscopy or positive screening test

data.name: Maximum Tolerated Dose Condition
data.description: Tirzepatide dose escalation target
data.text: Tirzepatide administered at the maximum tolerated dose (MTD), up to 15 mg

data.name: Hepatic Criteria for Study Drug Interruption or Discontinuation
data.description: Liver-related safety criteria triggering interruption or discontinuation (Section 7.1.3)
data.text: Hepatic criteria for study drug interruption or discontinuation are applied per protocol Section 7.1.3

data.name: Disease Progression Requiring Rescue Therapy
data.description: Condition triggering rescue therapy per Section 6.9.6
data.text: Disease progression as defined in Section 6.9.6 permits initiation of rescue therapy

data.name: Screening to Induction/Dose Escalation Transition
data.text: After a screening period of up to 5 weeks (≤35 days), participants meeting all eligibility criteria (including mMS 5-9 with Endoscopic Subscore 2-3 confirmed by central review within 21 days before Visit 2 and BMI criteria) are randomly assigned 1:1 to mirikizumab plus placebo or mirikizumab concomitantly administered with tirzepatide

data.name: Induction/Dose Escalation to Maintenance Transition
data.text: After completion of 24 weeks of Study Period II (Induction and Dose Escalation), participants continue into Study Period III (Maintenance Treatment) for 28 weeks

data.name: Maintenance to Safety Follow-up Transition
data.text: Safety follow-up occurs 4 weeks after the last visit (Week 52), yielding a maximum study duration of approximately 61 weeks

data.name: Tirzepatide Dose Escalation
data.text: Tirzepatide is dose-escalated during Study Period II (first 24 weeks) toward the maximum tolerated dose (up to 15 mg) per Section 6.1.4

data.name: Dose Modification for Mirikizumab or Tirzepatide
data.text: Dose modification rules for mirikizumab (Section 6.6.1) and tirzepatide (Section 6.6.2) are applied based on tolerability and adverse events

data.name: Temporary Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.text: Study intervention may be temporarily discontinued (interrupted) per Section 7.1.2, including for hepatic criteria per Section 7.1.3

data.name: Permanent Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.text: Permanent discontinuation of study intervention per Section 7.1.1, including discontinuation due to adverse events and meeting hepatic discontinuation criteria (Section 7.1.3). Participants with early permanent discontinuation are counted as nonresponders for the primary estimand.

data.name: Rescue Therapy for Disease Progression
data.text: Rescue therapy may be initiated in the setting of disease progression per Section 6.9.6; corticosteroid use and taper rules are specified in Section 6.9.5

data.name: Screen Failure and Rescreening for COVID-19
data.text: Participants who do not meet COVID-19 eligibility criteria must be screen failed and may only rescreen after at least 14 days have passed since recovery (symptomatic) or since first positive molecular test (asymptomatic)

data.name: Prohibited Medication Use
data.text: Use of specified prohibited medication is an intercurrent event addressed by the composite strategy; participants are considered nonresponders after the first occurrence. Prohibited concomitant medications are listed in Section 6.9.3.

data.name: Screen Failure
data.description: Participants not meeting eligibility criteria during the up to 5-week (≤35 day) screening period are screen failures; rescreening permitted for COVID-19 after ≥14 days when criteria are met

data.name: Participant Discontinuation/Withdrawal from Study
data.description: Participant discontinuation or withdrawal from the study per Section 7.2, which may occur at any time for any reason

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention due to Adverse Events
data.description: Permanent discontinuation of study intervention due to adverse events, serious adverse events, injection site reactions, or hepatic safety criteria (Sections 7.1.1 and 7.1.3)

data.name: Lost to Follow-Up
data.description: Participant is lost to follow-up per Section 7.3

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Completion of up to 52 weeks of treatment (24-week induction/dose escalation plus 28-week maintenance) and the 4-week safety follow-up, for a maximum total duration of approximately 61 weeks

data.name: Continued Access After End of Study
data.description: Continued access to study intervention after the end of the study may be provided per Section 6.7

data.name: Eligibility/Randomization Decision at Visit 2
data.description: At Visit 2, eligibility is confirmed (including centrally reviewed mMS 5-9 and Endoscopic Subscore 2-3 within 21 days before Visit 2 and required washout periods) and participants are randomized 1:1

data.name: Tirzepatide MTD Determination Decision
data.description: During the 24-week induction and dose escalation period, dose escalation continues until the maximum tolerated dose (up to 15 mg) is reached

data.name: Week 24 Metabolic and Clinical Assessment Decision
data.description: Week 24 assessment of percent change in body weight, BMI, waist circumference, HbA1c, and glucose at the transition from induction/dose escalation to maintenance

data.name: Week 52 Primary Endpoint Decision
data.description: Primary endpoint evaluation of simultaneous clinical remission and ≥10% weight reduction at Week 52 without early permanent discontinuation or prohibited medication use

data.name: Safety Discontinuation Decision
data.description: Ongoing decision point for temporary interruption or permanent discontinuation of study intervention based on hepatic and other safety criteria

data.name: Rescue Therapy Decision
data.description: Decision to initiate rescue therapy and/or corticosteroid taper in the event of disease progression
